moments.title: US Open Tennis Finals Weekend
moments.blurb: The final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, concludes this weekend with the Women's Singles Final on Saturday, September 12th, and the Men's Singles Final on Sunday, September 13th.

angles.name: Finals Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's taking home the silverware from Flushing Meadows? The US Open finals are this weekend – who are you backing to win the Men's and Women's titles?

angles.name: Weekend Sport
angles.copy: It's the business end of the US Open! Catch all the drama as the tennis elite battle it out for Grand Slam glory this Saturday and Sunday.

moments.title: Mark Ronson turns 51
moments.blurb: Grammy and Oscar-winning British-American DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson celebrates his 51st birthday today, September 4th.

angles.name: Today's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the absolute legend that is Mark Ronson! From 'Uptown Funk' to 'Valerie' and 'Shallow', his hits are undeniable. What's your favourite Ronson production?

angles.name: Producer Spotlight
angles.copy: The man behind so many iconic tracks, Mark Ronson, is 51 today! Producer, DJ, songwriter – he's done it all. Spinning some of his finest work to celebrate!

moments.title: Roger Waters turns 83
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter and co-founder of Pink Floyd, Roger Waters, will celebrate his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Roger Waters on September 6th! Co-founder and creative force behind Pink Floyd's masterpieces. Which of his lyrics resonate most with you?

angles.name: Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The legendary Roger Waters turns 83 on Sunday! A true visionary who shaped the sound of a generation with Pink Floyd. Get ready for some classic tracks!

moments.title: Macy Gray turns 59
moments.blurb: American R&B and soul singer Macy Gray, known for her distinctive raspy voice and hit 'I Try', will celebrate her 59th birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Unique Voice
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the one-of-a-kind Macy Gray on Sunday! Her voice is instantly recognisable and 'I Try' is a timeless classic. What's your favourite Macy Gray track?

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the soulful sound of Macy Gray, who turns 59 this Sunday! From 'On How Life Is' to her latest work, she continues to captivate. Tune in for her greatest hits!

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor turns 83
moments.blurb: Disco icon Gloria Gaynor, famous for the anthem 'I Will Survive', will celebrate her 83rd birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Queen
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Gloria Gaynor on Monday! The voice behind 'I Will Survive', an anthem for generations. What's your go-to disco classic?

angles.name: Monday Motivation
angles.copy: Get ready to survive and thrive! Disco legend Gloria Gaynor celebrates her 83rd birthday this Monday. We'll be playing her greatest hits to get your week started right!

moments.title: Pink turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer and songwriter Pink (Alecia Beth Moore-Hart) will celebrate her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Pop-Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to the incredible Pink on Tuesday! A true pop-rock powerhouse known for her powerful vocals and acrobatic performances. What's your favourite Pink anthem?

angles.name: Birthday Playlist
angles.copy: It's Pink's birthday on Tuesday! Get ready for a playlist packed with her biggest hits and empowering anthems. She's 47 and still rocking!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 this September, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off Excitement
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns to Channel 4 this month, with Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Buzz
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The new series of The Great British Bake Off is back this September on Channel 4. What do you think she'll bring to the judging table?

moments.title: Reminisce Festival 2026
moments.blurb: The Reminisce Festival, a huge celebration of 90s and 00s dance music, returns to Sherdley Park, St Helens on Saturday, September 12th, featuring acts like Baby D, Basshunter, East 17, Liberty X, N-Trance, Phats & Small, and Vengaboys.

angles.name: 90s/00s Throwback
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive throwback! Reminisce Festival is hitting St Helens on September 12th with a huge lineup of 90s and 00s dance legends. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Dance Anthems
angles.copy: Calling all dance music lovers! Reminisce Festival is bringing the biggest 90s and 00s anthems to Sherdley Park next Saturday. It's going to be epic!

moments.title: Worcester Music Festival
moments.blurb: The Worcester Music Festival, the UK's largest donation-entry festival, runs from September 11th to 13th, featuring over 250 performances across 25 venues, supporting a local cause.

angles.name: Local Music Scene
angles.copy: Worcester Music Festival is almost here! From September 11th-13th, enjoy over 250 performances across the city, all while supporting a great local cause. Discover your new favourite band!

angles.name: Festival for a Cause
angles.copy: Music for a good cause! The Worcester Music Festival kicks off next Friday, offering three days of diverse acts across 25 venues. It's the UK's largest donation-entry festival!

moments.title: Nas turns 53
moments.blurb: American rapper, songwriter, and record producer Nasir bin Olu Dara Jones, known mononymously as Nas, will celebrate his 53rd birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 53rd Birthday to the legendary Nas on September 14th! One of the greatest lyricists of all time, with an incredible catalogue from 'Illmatic' to 'King's Disease'. What's your top Nas track?

angles.name: Birthday Vibes
angles.copy: Celebrating the incomparable Nas, who turns 53 next Monday! Get ready to hear some of his most influential tracks as we salute a true hip hop icon.
